expedition.grove.start: The Moonmoth slips past the last warm lantern and into the dew-bright grove.
expedition.grove.dewpath: A silver path bends beneath broad leaves, quiet enough to hear droplets fall.
expedition.grove.moss: Soft moss gathers along the roots, ready to be carried home.
expedition.grove.whisper: A hush moves through the ferns and hints at a path most travelers miss.
expedition.grove.hidden: Behind the ferns, a small hidden cache waits in blue moonlight.
expedition.grove.hollow: The trail settles at a sheltered hollow before first light.
expedition.bramble.start: The Moonmoth climbs from the grove toward the red-leaf rise.
expedition.bramble.slope: Bramble branches frame a steep path above the cloud sea.
expedition.bramble.thorns: The trail narrows through warm thornwood and asks for patient footing.
expedition.bramble.cloud: A break in the cloud reveals a quieter route along the ridge.
expedition.bramble.cache: A weathered trail cache rests beneath a bent branch.
expedition.bramble.relic: Cloudlight catches on something old and carefully hidden.
expedition.bramble.peak: The Moonmoth reaches the high ridge as the horizon begins to brighten.
